mapper.select: SELECT question.content AS question, answer.content AS answer FROM chat_message current_turn JOIN chat_message answer ON answer.conversation_id = current_turn.conversation_id AND (answer.created_at, answer.id) < (current_turn.created_at, current_turn.id) JOIN chat_message question ON question.conversation_id = answer.conversation_id AND question.turn_id = answer.turn_id AND question.role = 'USER' WHERE current_turn.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND current_turn.turn_id = #{currentTurnId,typeHandler=com.lnjecit.knowledge.assistant.infrastructure.persistence.UuidTypeHandler} AND current_turn.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND answer.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND answer.status = 'ANSWERED' AND question.content IS NOT NULL AND answer.content IS NOT NULL ORDER BY answer.created_at DESC, answer.id DESC LIMIT 3
